items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was there with Nixon a couple times... and with – what’s the one that succeeded Carter? The Republican? [INTERVIEWER] Reagan. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He had a real snobbish party.

ctx.x: I’ve been there so many times I can’t even – I’d say roughly a dozen times. I was there with Nixon a couple times, with Johnson a couple times, with Lady Bird [Johnson], her Christmas party, with Carter a couple times, and with – what’s the one that succeeded Carter? The Republican?
Yeah. He had a real snobbish party. He had guards that escorted everybody to their seats.
